# Collector core requirements exempt from check-collector-module-version.
# Format: <module directory> <collector module>. Every other collector requirement
# of these modules is still checked against the fork-wide pin.
#
# These modules depend on github.com/prometheus/prometheus v0.314.0, which requires
# go.opentelemetry.io/collector core v1.63.0 / v0.157.0. Minimal version selection
# therefore raises these requirements above the fork-wide pin. Prometheus releases
# that fit the pin (v0.311.x) carry unfixed github.com/docker/docker advisories
# (GO-2026-4887, GO-2026-4883), so the fork took the newer Prometheus
# (SAW-11264, #113). Remove entries when the fork syncs its collector core to the
# Prometheus requirement; the check fails if an entry no longer differs from the pin.
